collection.title: Vauxhall Ampera 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Ampera 2011 Onwards requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
